title: The page's side of the telemetry lanes and the cap: at most 40 events a tab with a marker when the cap is hit (capped, skipped by tens), lost writes counted (lost: n), and the five lanes with a fallback on 507, 404 and 5xx
note: The code is in records/briefs/2026-10-27__brief__five-lanes-and-a-cap-per-tab.md. The server side is done (five lanes on 84wr8mib, 27 October). Why: on 26 October one Googlebot rendering session sent 960 events and filled the lane, which refused everything for about 4¾ hours. assets/telemetry.js is in the press (security's review); the five tokens are in the telemetry vault's identity/lanes.json, publishable, and observability will hand them to dev. The hosts check is already done (board 330). Priority, observability's view: the cap and its markers first (they stop the 26 October case on their own), the lanes second. The markers answer the editor's question of 27 October: a capped tab must not look like one that read 40 pages.
